name: Akzo Nobel India Limited
remarksWeb: In terms of the SEBI Circular on Discloure of Significant Beneficial Ownership in the shareholding pattern- the Company is required to submit the details in line with the requirements specified under the Companies (Significant Beneficial Onwers) Rules, 2018- In terms of Companies (Significant Beneficial Onwers) Rules, 2018 -the said Rules are not applicable to the extent the shares of the Reporting Company are held by its Holding Reporting Company. Therefore, in e-Form BEN-2 -the Company is only required to mention the name of its Holding Company i.e. JSW Paints Limited.

name: Akzo Nobel India Limited
remarksWeb: The Company has transferred 302643 Equity Shares of Rs.10/- each i.e. 0.66% of the total paid-up equity share capital to the Investor Education and Protection Fund. As per the Investor Education and Protection Fund  Authority (Accounitng, Audit, Transfer and Refund) Rules, 2016 (IEPF) as amended, the voting rights on shares transferred to IEPF shall remain frozen until the rightful owner claims the shares.
